text: Solicitation Issued: July 11, 2019 Solicitation Closed: September 12, 2019 Number of Addenda Issued: Three (3) Number of Bids: Eight (8)

The Bid Award Panel adopted the following: 1. Bid Award Panel grant authority to award the contract in accordance with the Contract Details set out in the report (July 16, 2020) from the Chief Procurement Officer: Solicitation Number: Sourcewell Request for Proposal Number 091219-CRB Description: Leveraging from Sourcewell request for Proposal (RFP) Number 091219-CRB for the non-exclusive supply and delivery of six (6) refuse collection trucks (cabover truck chassis with 8 cubic yard dual stream slideload packer body), including warranty and non-warranty parts and services for a period of forty (40) months, from July 1, 2020 to November 15, 2023 with the option to renew the contract for one (1) additional optional year from November 16, 2023 to November 15, 2024. Recommended Supplier: Nexgen Municipal Inc. Contract Award Value: $5,789,016 net of all applicable taxes and charges…
